# Read-only kernel clock probe (WSL Ubuntu, shared VM kernel). Samples REALTIME/MONOTONIC/MONOTONIC_RAW
# every 0.25 s and reads adjtimex (modes=0, no privilege, changes nothing).
import ctypes, time, json, sys
class timeval(ctypes.Structure): _fields_=[('tv_sec',ctypes.c_long),('tv_usec',ctypes.c_long)]
class timex(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('modes',ctypes.c_uint),('offset',ctypes.c_long),('freq',ctypes.c_long),('maxerror',ctypes.c_long),('esterror',ctypes.c_long),
              ('status',ctypes.c_int),('constant',ctypes.c_long),('precision',ctypes.c_long),('tolerance',ctypes.c_long),('time',timeval),
              ('tick',ctypes.c_long),('ppsfreq',ctypes.c_long),('jitter',ctypes.c_long),('shift',ctypes.c_int),('stabil',ctypes.c_long),
              ('jitcnt',ctypes.c_long),('calcnt',ctypes.c_long),('errcnt',ctypes.c_long),('stbcnt',ctypes.c_long),('tai',ctypes.c_int),('pad',ctypes.c_int*11)]
libc=ctypes.CDLL('libc.so.6',use_errno=True)
def adj():
    t=timex(); t.modes=0; state=libc.adjtimex(ctypes.byref(t))
    return {'state':state,'tick':t.tick,'freq_ppm':round(t.freq/65536,3),'offset':t.offset,'status':t.status,'maxerror':t.maxerror,'esterror':t.esterror,
            'applied_ppm':round((t.tick-10000)*100+t.freq/65536,1)}
R,M,W=time.CLOCK_REALTIME,time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC,time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW
dur=float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 95
r0,m0,w0=time.clock_gettime(R),time.clock_gettime(M),time.clock_gettime(W)
first=adj(); steps=[]; prev=(r0-m0); adjs=[first]
while time.clock_gettime(W)-w0<dur:
    time.sleep(0.25)
    r,m,w=time.clock_gettime(R),time.clock_gettime(M),time.clock_gettime(W)
    if abs((r-m)-prev)>0.05: steps.append({'at_raw_s':round(w-w0,2),'step_ms':round(((r-m)-prev)*1000,1)})
    prev=r-m
    if int(w-w0)%15==0 and (w-w0)%15<0.26: adjs.append(adj())
r1,m1,w1=time.clock_gettime(R),time.clock_gettime(M),time.clock_gettime(W)
out={'raw_elapsed_s':round(w1-w0,3),'monotonic_minus_raw_ppm':round(((m1-m0)-(w1-w0))/(w1-w0)*1e6,1),
     'realtime_minus_monotonic_ms':round(((r1-r0)-(m1-m0))*1000,1),'steps':steps,'adjtimex_samples':adjs+[adj()]}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=1))
summary: Read-only kernel clock probe: REALTIME/MONOTONIC/MONOTONIC_RAW rates, calendar steps and adjtimex tick/frequency (shared WSL kernel); expected clock_changed
